title: placeholder hint conflict
rule: CONFLICT — NN/g: do not use placeholder as the label; put essential hints outside the field so they stay visible. Apple HIG: a text field may show placeholder hint text to communicate purpose, and because that text disappears also include a separate label. Tidwell Input Prompt fills an empty field with a prompt of expected input; Tidwell Input Hints put an explanatory comment next to the field (NN/g side). Dual-cite; not two winners.

citation.source: NN/g — Placeholders in Form Fields Are Harmful; Apple HIG — Text fields; Apple HIG — Entering data; Designing Interfaces 3e ch. Getting Input — Input Hints; Input Prompt (Tidwell, Brewer, Valencia)

pass_when: A separate label is present. If in-field hint/prompt exists, it is extra, not the only name for the field. Essential format/help that must stay readable is also available outside the field (NN/g / Tidwell hints) without treating Apple’s extra hint as a fail.
fail_when: Placeholder or in-field prompt is the only label (agreed fail across the cites).
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
